claude_proposed_widenings.name: ReactionTrigger::see_creature_casting_spell
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Counterspell fires when the caster sees any creature within 60 feet casting a spell with V, S, or M components. The existing trigger variants (hit_by_attack_roll, targeted_by_named_spell, any_of) cannot express this general 'observe a creature casting' condition. This is a qualitatively different trigger shape: it is observer-relative, not self-relative, and it matches on any casting rather than a named spell targeting you.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: which you take when you see a creature within 60 feet of yourself casting a spell with Verbal, Somatic, or Material components

claude_proposed_widenings.name: ReactionEffect::save_gate_negate_current_casting
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Counterspell's effect is a save-gated negate of the spell currently being cast, with explicit slot preservation on failure. Neither existing variant applies: modify_ac is unrelated; negate_named_effect requires a fixed spellId known at authoring time and has no save gate. Counterspell targets 'the spell being cast' (a runtime reference, not a static spellId) and conditionally preserves the caster's spell slot when the save fails. These two properties together — dynamic target + embedded Con save + slot-preservation clause — require a new ReactionEffect variant.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: The creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the spell dissipates with no effect, and the action, Bonus Action, or Reaction used to cast it is wasted. If that spell was cast with a spell slot, the slot isn't expended.

discrepancies: no content/counterspell.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
